name: web-brutalist-pink-and-black-music-label-identity-site
title: Underground music label site in hot pink and black with stamp-brush type and halftone crowd
whatItIs: A very tall page in black and hot pink: a giant blocky pink brush wordmark over a pink-toned crowd photo, boxed pink cards, brush-lettered headings, a brand characteristics table, colour chips, a torn pink-and-black terrain graphic with four annotated boxes, and a pink-toned drummer photo with 'Step into the noise' and a giant footer wordmark.
whatItMeans: Raw and loud; rough brush lettering and pink duotone photos feel like a physical zine.
techniques: Set headings in rough stamped letters.
Draw torn terrain shapes as dividers.

vocabulary.definition: Letters that look rubber-stamped and rough.
An image in one colour plus black.
Small corner marks used in print as decoration.
